capabilities: Colour folder nodes from configured folder colour rules
Colour graph lines that touch matching folders
Combine same-name folders in Graph View
Add attachment and folder filters to the Graph View filter panel
Prefix folder labels with emoji and bold configured labels
disambiguation: Does not manage, rename, or move folders; it only changes how folder nodes look in Graph View.
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Folder and Graphs Plus extends Folder2Graph-style folder nodes in Obsidian's Graph View.
problem: Obsidian's native Graph View does not colour folder nodes by configurable folder rules, label them with emoji, or filter attachments by extension.

relations.evidence: extends Folder2Graph-style folder nodes in Obsidian's Graph View

summary: Graph View add-on that colours Folder2Graph folder nodes by folder rules and adds emoji labels and attachment filters.
